regression_risk: High — complex pose with multiple joint changes. LEFT leg repositioned from standing to back-swept-up (leftHip -70, leftKnee 160). spine doubled in magnitude (-5→-30). LEFT arm raised overhead and swung behind (leftShoulder -110, shoulderFwdL=+50 per corrected convention + = behind). Hand-foot contact rig-limited (distance wristL-to-footL still ~1.36m — renderer lacks hip-origin-y control and isolated torso twist).
rationale: Description: Low lunge with one knee down + sweep back leg up + hold ankle with same-side hand + torso opens toward camera + deep backbend. RIGHT leg preserved as kneeling lunge base (rightHip=70, rightKnee=80). Fixes: (1) spine -5→-30 (deep backbend per tip warm up... this deep stretch); (2) leftHip 0→-70 (LEFT leg swings BACK per corrected convention + = forward, so negative = back); (3) leftKnee 20→160 (deep flexion, foot comes up to hip level — rig-limited, foot reaches y=0.024 not higher); (4) leftShoulder -10→-110 (LEFT arm overhead, PR-v4-style raise); (5) leftElbow 100→30 (LEFT arm extended for reach); (6) shoulderFwdL 12→50 (LEFT arm swings BEHIND body per corrected convention + = behind, reaching back/down for foot); (7) rightShoulder 8→0, rightElbow 100→60 (RIGHT arm at side, less bent); (8) neck 12→0 (neutral). Result: LEFT leg lifted (foot at hip level y=0.024), LEFT arm overhead reaching back (wristL at (-0.790,1.075,-0.278)), spine deep arch (-30). Hand-to-foot contact rig-limited (distance 1.36m) — true ankle-hold not achievable without renderer hip-origin-y control.
